scope: p4096 grouped Q5 down plus route-weight/scatter/ordered-reduce

current_abi.reducer: token-major top-k loop using lane_to_row and fmaf(BF16(value), F32(weight), accumulator)

finding: The Q5 owner is expert-major while the exact reduction is token-major; lanes for one token span independently scheduled expert CTAs.
Publishing preweighted F32 rows changes arithmetic because it rounds value*weight before the later addition instead of preserving the incumbent FMA(value, weight, accumulator).
Publishing BF16 rows preserves the boundary but leaves the complete weighting/reduction pass intact, so it is not an operation-complete mechanism.

Performing exact ordered reduction inside expert-major CTAs requires cross-CTA global coordination; atomics do not preserve top-k order. Reassigning the projection to token-major ownership discards the measured expert-row weight reuse and is a new kernel family, not an epilogue.
decision: Do not implement a nominal fused epilogue. Exact Q5 down+route is blocked by the ownership boundary. A future candidate must either retain token-major FMA reduction through a cooperative/persistent owner or enter T1/T2 production numerics explicitly.
